description: Power Usage Effectiveness assumed for hyperscale data centres.
source: Shehabi et al. 2024; hyperscale and colocation average PUE below 1.4 in 2023, with sector average projected toward 1.15-1.35 by 2028.

description: Annual average capacity-utilization proxy for hyperscale facilities.
source: Shehabi et al. 2024; hyperscale conventional server operational time around 50% by 2027.

description: Power Usage Effectiveness assumed for hyperscale AI data centres.
source: Shehabi et al. 2024; AI air/liquid cooling treated separately, with high UPS efficiency assumptions.

description: Annual average capacity-utilization proxy for hyperscale AI facilities.
source: Shehabi et al. 2024; AI training operational power and operational-time assumptions.

description: Power Usage Effectiveness assumed for AI/HPC-oriented facilities.
source: Shehabi et al. 2024; AI data centres modelled separately for air and liquid cooling.

description: Annual average capacity-utilization proxy for AI/HPC-oriented facilities.
source: Shehabi et al. 2024; AI training operational time 75-85% and operational power 60-80% of rated power.

description: Power Usage Effectiveness assumed for colocation facilities with AI workloads.
source: Shehabi et al. 2024; hyperscale and colocation average PUE below 1.4 in 2023.

description: Annual average capacity-utilization proxy for colocation facilities with AI workloads.
source: Shehabi et al. 2024; colocation conventional server operational time around 35% by 2027, adjusted upward for AI/HPC workload.

description: Power Usage Effectiveness assumed for colocation facilities.
source: Shehabi et al. 2024; hyperscale and colocation average PUE below 1.4 in 2023.

description: Annual average capacity-utilization proxy for conventional colocation.
source: Shehabi et al. 2024; colocation server operational time around 35% by 2027.
